source: UN SDG Global Database (UNSD SDG API)
measurement_note: These are executable catalogue/data contracts and human review scenarios. The runner does not call a language model; automated passes do not prove natural-language selection or answer quality.

cases.user_question: Show historical UHC service coverage index for the WHO Western Pacific Region.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve every available observation year; do not interpolate missing years.
important_notes: Check the published UNSD WHO Western Pacific aggregate. Identify the 2025 UHC methodology and report any membership caveat; never average country indexes.

Coverage checked on 2026-09-16 for release 2026.Q2.G.02: area 99047 exists, but UHC has zero matching observations; the global indicator baseline has data. Expect filters_no_data. A catalogue-valid region does not guarantee series coverage.
cases.expectation_correction: An initial nonempty expectation confused area catalogue membership with series coverage. The API output was not changed; the original failed expectation is retained in report history.

cases.user_question: Compare historical UHC service coverage index in China, Japan and the Philippines.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve all available years for each country; retain unequal coverage.
important_notes: Keep the series and methodology constant across countries; do not fabricate missing years.

cases.user_question: Get the Philippines UHC SCI from 2015 onwards.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retain observed years greater than or equal to 2015, including the latest available.
important_notes: The latest available year can precede the current year.

cases.user_question: What is the latest available UHC service coverage index in Japan?
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve complete coverage, then select the maximum observed year for this series and scope.
important_notes: State the actual observation year; the current calendar year is not a data value.

cases.user_question: What was the Philippines UHC service coverage index in 2026?
cases.expected_year_logic: Apply the explicit 2026 to 2026 filter; do not substitute the latest available year.
important_notes: If no rows survive the filter, report filters_no_data. Do not extrapolate or claim the indicator does not exist.

cases.user_question: Get SDG tuberculosis incidence per 100,000 people in the Philippines since 2015.
cases.expected_year_logic: Return every available year from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Use the rate series, state the denominator, and preserve any sex or age strata.

cases.user_question: Show SDG TB incidence in the Philippines.
cases.expected_year_logic: After selecting the verified SDG series, retrieve all available years.
important_notes: The SDG catalogue offers a standard incidence rate. State that choice explicitly; do not claim it is a count.

cases.user_question: Get the under-five mortality rate in the Philippines since 2015, showing all sex categories.
cases.expected_year_logic: Return all available observed years from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Keep sex categories separate. Do not sum rates or average female and male rates.

cases.user_question: How many children died before age five in China in 2020?
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve the requested observation year 2020 only.
important_notes: Select the deaths count series, not the under-five mortality rate.

cases.user_question: Show SDG 3.2.1 results for Japan.
cases.expected_year_logic: Discuss the requested series before retrieving all available years.
important_notes: The indicator includes a mortality rate and a deaths count; they have different units and cannot be merged into one result.

cases.user_question: Show neonatal mortality rates for China and Japan from 2010 to 2020, retaining any sex breakdown.
cases.expected_year_logic: Keep years from 2010 through 2020 inclusive.
important_notes: Use neonatal rate, not number of neonatal deaths; preserve bounds and sex.

cases.user_question: Get the maternal mortality ratio for the Philippines from 2015 to 2023.
cases.expected_year_logic: Keep observed years from 2015 through 2023 inclusive.
important_notes: State the unit from returned metadata and preserve uncertainty bounds; do not label the ratio as a number of deaths.

cases.user_question: What proportion of births were attended by skilled health personnel in Indonesia since 2015?
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve all observed years from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Retain missingness and any reporting-type differences rather than creating annual observations.

cases.user_question: Show all available sex and age breakdowns of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected people in the Philippines in 2020.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve 2020 only and retain each distinct sex/age stratum.
important_notes: Do not collapse all age groups into a national estimate. A display value such as <0.01 remains text if it is not numeric.

cases.user_question: Get malaria incidence per 1,000 people at risk in Papua New Guinea since 2015.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve every observed year from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: The population at risk is the denominator, not all residents.

cases.user_question: Get premature mortality from cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes or chronic respiratory disease in Japan, keeping sex breakdowns.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve complete available history for the selected series.
important_notes: Describe the series as the published probability measure and preserve sex; do not invent a crude rate.

cases.user_question: Compare female and male suicide mortality rates in Japan from 2015 onwards.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve observed years from 2015 inclusive, retaining separate female and male values.
important_notes: Inspect dimension metadata before filtering and do not substitute both-sex results.
cases.expectation_correction: The initial test used SDMX aliases F/M. Official API metadata and observations use FEMALE/MALE in the code field. Query arguments were corrected; returned values were not changed.

cases.user_question: Get the road traffic death rate for the Philippines in 2021, with all sex categories.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve 2021 only; if absent, report the empty filter rather than another year.
important_notes: Select the per-100,000 rate rather than the deaths-count series.

cases.user_question: Show alcohol consumption per capita aged 15 and older in Japan since 2010.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve every observed year from 2010 inclusive.
important_notes: Preserve litre units and age population; do not interpret the value as prevalence of alcohol use disorder.

cases.user_question: Show demand for family planning satisfied with modern methods in the Philippines since 2015.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve observed years from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Inspect and retain relevant marital-status/population strata; do not merge overlapping groups.

cases.user_question: Show adolescent birth rates in the Philippines separately for ages 10–14 and 15–19.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve all available observation years for both requested age groups.
important_notes: Keep ages 10–14 and 15–19 distinct and report per-1,000-women units.

cases.user_question: Get DTP3 vaccine coverage in the Philippines since 2015.
cases.expected_year_logic: Return every observed year from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Confirm the DTP3 series; an indicator-level response may also contain MCV2, HPV and PCV3.

cases.user_question: Get measles-containing-vaccine second-dose coverage in the Philippines since 2015.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve all observed years from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: This is MCV2 coverage, not reported measles cases. Do not substitute the GHO reported-case indicator.

cases.user_question: Show vaccination coverage in the Philippines.
cases.expected_year_logic: Clarify the vaccine before retrieving the requested or complete history.
important_notes: Different vaccines have different target populations; one combined vaccine percentage is invalid.

cases.user_question: Get age-standardized tobacco use prevalence in Japan since 2015, by sex.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve all observed years from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Keep the age-standardized population aged 15 and over and preserve sex strata.

cases.user_question: Show health worker density in the Philippines.
cases.expected_year_logic: Clarify occupation before selecting a comparable history.
important_notes: Medical doctors, nursing staff and other occupations cannot be summed or treated as one interchangeable series.

cases.user_question: Get the current SDG 3.8.2 financial hardship definition and available series.
cases.expected_year_logic: Inspect the current catalogue and metadata; do not infer available years without querying coverage.
important_notes: The current definition is expenditure exceeding 40% of household discretionary budget; preserve the changed methodology.

cases.user_question: Find catastrophic health spending above 10% of household expenditure in the SDG database.
cases.expected_year_logic: Determine whether the requested legacy definition is available before any time-series retrieval.
important_notes: The verified current series is a related candidate, not a substitute for >10%. Explain the mismatch and ask whether the user needs the historical definition or the current one.

cases.user_question: Show the current SDG 3.8.2 series in the Philippines, retaining every household and location breakdown.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve complete available history without generating annual values between surveys.
important_notes: Label the 40%-of-discretionary-budget definition explicitly and keep all disaggregations separate.

cases.user_question: Get safely managed drinking water coverage in the Philippines since 2015, with urban and rural estimates separate.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve every observed year from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Keep urban/rural categories distinct; basic water service is a different concept.

cases.user_question: Get safely managed sanitation coverage for Tokelau from 2015 onwards, with all geographic breakdowns.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve observed years from 2015 inclusive; a valid area can have no rows for a selected series.
important_notes: Tokelau is in the UNSD area catalogue but not the DSIR WHO Member State mapping. Retain M49 772, preserve the UN name and leave ISO3 missing.

cases.user_question: Show stunting prevalence among children under five in the Philippines from 2015 onwards.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve every available observation year from 2015 inclusive.
important_notes: Select the percentage series rather than the number in thousands; preserve strata.

cases.user_question: Find the SDG indicator for safely managed drinking water rather than basic drinking water.
cases.expected_year_logic: This is discovery only; no observation-year filter is needed.
important_notes: Do not choose the 1.4.1 basic drinking water series.

cases.user_question: Show all available years of the global UHC service coverage index.
cases.expected_year_logic: Retrieve every available global observation year.
important_notes: Use the published World aggregate, not a mean of countries and not World by SDG regions.

cases.user_question: Compare WHO Western Pacific UHC history using a fixed set of countries before and after Indonesia joined.
cases.expected_year_logic: Clarify the intended fixed membership and comparison period before analysis.
important_notes: The official aggregate is available but does not answer a custom fixed-membership index request. Do not average country UHC indexes; no derived regional index is produced.

cases.user_question: Get indicator 99.99.99 for the Philippines.
cases.expected_year_logic: Reject the unverified indicator before fetching observations; no year rule applies.
important_notes: Return indicator_not_found after successful catalogue validation; never fabricate an indicator.

cases.user_question: Show UHC service coverage for Atlantis.
cases.expected_year_logic: Resolve the location before retrieving any observations.
important_notes: Ask for a real geographic scope after unknown_location; do not silently request all countries.

cases.user_question: Use the series SH_ACS_UNHC to show UHC history for the Philippines.
cases.expected_year_logic: Validate the supplied series against the current catalogue before retrieving historical observations.
important_notes: The supplied legacy series is absent from the verified catalogue. Explain that SH_ACS_UNHC_25 uses the 2025 methodology; do not silently substitute it.

cases.user_question: Do Philippines, PHL and 608 refer to the same SDG geographic area?
cases.expected_year_logic: Location resolution only; no time-period selection is needed.
important_notes: Resolve equivalent forms without duplicate requests. The API uses M49 area codes.

cases.user_question: 请确认西太区、WPRO 和 Western Pacific Region 在 SDG 数据库里的区域代码。
cases.expected_year_logic: Location resolution only; historical membership cannot be inferred from a code alone.
important_notes: Resolve all aliases to the official UNSD WHO Western Pacific area; no hardcoded country expansion.
